fee_notes: Standard Initial License Fee is $25,000, including for captive venue locations. Fees received in the U.S. in 2025 ranged from $12,500 to $25,000; the $12,500 amount was previously negotiated with multi-restaurant licensees opening new restaurants under existing agreement terms (which provide for a generally shorter term than the current 10-year initial term). Franchisor may negotiate different fee amounts as appropriate. Fee is fully earned upon written authorization for the Restaurant and is entirely non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: The Initial License Fee (as defined in the Agreement) offered for new licensees is $25,000, including for captive venue locations. All licensees must pay an Initial License Fee, even if the licensee is a joint venture company formed with our Affiliate. We may negotiate different fee amounts and other terms as we consider appropriate, subject to applicable law. Initial License Fees received in the U.S. in 2025 ranged from $12,500 to $25,000, with the $12,500 amount having been previously negotiated with multi-restaurant licensees opening new restaurants under existing agreement terms (which provide for a generally shorter term than our current 10-year initial term).
